'''Cocoa''' (Japanese: '''チョウコ''' ''Chōko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP086|Arriving in Style!]]''. She is a famous [[Pokémon Stylist]] from [[Hearthome City]].

She entered the [[Hearthome Collection]] fashion show alongside {{an|Dawn}}, {{Ash}}, and [[Jessie#In the Diamond & Pearl series|Jessilina]]. Cocoa appeared to be conceited and somewhat of a snob. For example, she yelled at [[Dawn's Buneary]] because the latter wanted to touch her dress. She also made fun of her for no discernible reason.

During the competition, Cocoa put on a show with her {{p|Mismagius}}. However, [[Hermione]], one of the judges, was not impressed. Cocoa nonetheless made it into the top three, along with Ash and Dawn. Much to her dislike, she ended up in second place, while Dawn won the prize.
